derivation:
by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using (he.ker_toSpanSingleton_one_sub_eq_span.symm.le x.property)
explanation: Mathlib identifies the ideal generated by e with the kernel of multiplication by 1 − e. Applying this equality to x gives the desired annihilation, after coercing to R and commuting multiplication. Its proof is independent of the target theorem.
